Install any icons referenced in config but not yet on disk

Usage: wayle icons sync [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --dry-run
          Preview what would be installed without making changes

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
    wayle icons sync
        -> install every config-referenced icon not yet on disk

    wayle icons sync --dry-run
        -> list what would be installed; no downloads

Useful when sharing dotfiles across machines. User-imported `cm-` icons
cannot be auto-installed and are listed as skipped.
